title: description
description: A community-authored, SPOILER-FREE description of one work - what a stranger reads before deciding to listen. A per-work sidecar in the CC BY-SA layer, kept separate from the CC0 core. Unlike recaps it is gated by no position, and unlike a recap summary's in_short it never states the ending.

text.description: Own-words description: the setup, the premise and the hook, with no reveal past the opening act. Length-capped for the copyright reference-guide tier; verbatim/near-verbatim phrasing is a separate publish-pipeline check, and a rewritten retailer blurb is never acceptable. The 200-character floor is deliberate - a one-line stub is thinner than the facts the pages already state.
